name: Of Love and Family
label: Quest
description: Of Love and Family: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When Taelan was a child, we would oft visit Caer Darrow on family excursions. On our last visit, an artist by the name of Renfray painted a portrait of us poised along the beachside. It is my fondest memory of both Taelan and Karandra. For it was at that moment, with my wife and son in my arms, that I felt a bond of love and family that I would never know again.
If this painting still exists, you must find it.
Travel to the ruined island of Caer Darrow and see if the painting or the artist remain.

clips.title: Completion
paras: How could I forget? Many of the spirits on this island are cursed to relive their last happy memory before they met their tragic end.
I too am cursed, but not as they - I am one of the few that remembers all...
Perhaps this thing that you ask me is why I haunt these ruins. Perhaps this thing I tell you shall set me free.
